description: Source code for the DumpPool class managing thread pool and temporary files in the dumpstate component of Android.

classes.name: DumpPool
classes.description: Manages a thread pool for dumping state information, handles temporary files, and coordinates dump tasks.

classes.name: DumpPool::TmpFile
classes.description: Represents a temporary file used during dump operations.

methods.name: WaitForTask
methods.description: Waits for a future task to complete, then dumps its result to a file descriptor.

methods.name: DumpPool::DumpPool
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dump pool with a temporary root directory.

methods.name: DumpPool::~DumpPool
methods.description: Destructor that shuts down the thread pool and cleans up temporary files.

methods.name: DumpPool::start
methods.description: Starts the thread pool with a specified number of threads.

methods.name: DumpPool::deleteTempFiles
methods.description: Deletes temporary files in the specified directory.

methods.name: DumpPool::setLogDuration
methods.description: Sets whether to log duration of dump tasks.

methods.name: DumpPool::invokeTask
methods.description: Invokes a dump task with duration reporting.

methods.name: DumpPool::createTempFile
methods.description: Creates a new temporary file for dumping data.

methods.name: DumpPool::setThreadName
methods.description: Sets the thread name for a thread in the pool.

methods.name: DumpPool::loop
methods.description: Main loop for worker threads to process tasks.
